WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_purchase_ts,
    (MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) - INTERVAL '24 months') AS start_ts
  FROM orders o
),
top_categories AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS category_name,
    ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS total_sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
  JOIN params ON TRUE
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= params.start_ts
  GROUP BY COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown')
  ORDER BY total_sales DESC
  LIMIT 10
)
SELECT
  to_char(DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month,
  tc.category_name,
  ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS monthly_sales
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
JOIN top_categories tc ON COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') = tc.category_name
JOIN params ON TRUE
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= params.start_ts
GROUP BY year_month, tc.category_name
ORDER BY tc.category_name, year_month;
